name: moveToSpot
doc: when user asks you to move to a specific spot in the world, use this action. The parameter is the name of the spot.

name: moveToPoint
args: x: float, y: float, z: float
doc: when the user asks you to go to an arbitrary point in the world, use this action. The parameters are the x, y, and z coordinates of the point.

name: talk
doc: use this action when the user asks you something or where a comment to some other action is appropriate. The parameter is the text you want to say.

name: grab
doc: pick up a named object from the environment

name: place
args: x: float, y: float, z: float
doc: put the held object down at these world coordinates. The parameters are the x, y, and z of the drop point.
